profile.name: subscriber2
profile.preferences: I follow current affairs and I just want the big news — major announcements, decisions, new dates and milestones, like a launch actually happening. Keep my reels short, under a minute. Please skip politics, budgets and long technical details.

title: Artemis I Night Launch - SLS and Orion to the Moon
recap: You got the go for launch, the liftoff of Artemis One, booster separation in flight, and confirmation all four solar arrays deployed. These are the major decisions and milestones from the broadcast.

verification.shows: Launch director in control room gives go to resume count for Artemis One launch
Live night launch of Artemis I SLS with engine hydrogen burn-off, ignition and liftoff ascending on bright plume
Night live footage shows two solid rocket boosters separating and trailing fire as the core stage continues flight
Audio confirms all four solar arrays deployed over overexposed live spacecraft view and Mission Control Center
